name: Fallout 4 (keyboard)
_sources: PC keyboard defaults (Esc pause, F5/F9 quicksave/quickload, 1-0 hotkeys, Tab Pip-Boy, Q VATS, WASD, E activate, R ready/reload, F favorites, Shift sprint, Ctrl sneak, Alt bash/power attack/grenade, Space jump, X toggle always run, C auto move, V toggle POV, Mouse1 attack, Mouse2 aim/block): https://www.magicgameworld.com/fallout-4-controls-guide-pc-xbox-and-playstation/

Xbox One layout (A activate, B Pip-Boy, X ready/reload and hold to holster, Y jump, Start pause, Back POV, RB bash/power attack/hold grenade, LB VATS, RT attack, LT aim/block, L3 sprint, R3 sneak, D-pad favorites): same page and https://fallout4.wiki.fextralife.com/Controls (its 'LB - Aim/Block' line is a typo for LT)
Esc pause, 1-9/0/-/= favorites, F5/F9 quicksave/quickload: https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Fallout_4/Controls (via search snippet, page itself blocked)

Mapping: D-pad up = F favorites menu; D-pad left = T (Wait), D-pad right = G; the number hotkeys 1-0 are reached through the F favorites menu (no spare inputs, the pad has 17); D-pad down = Enter (Return) to confirm menus, dialogue and the Pip-Boy, chosen because it replaces only a third hotkey; GUIDE = F5 quicksave; holding X = holding R (holster).

UNVERIFIED by any source: hold R to holster on PC (only the Xbox hold is documented), T = Wait and G (user-requested, no source in the pages read), Pip-Boy light (not bound), workshop/build-mode keys (not bound; E select, mouse place are conventional). Not reachable (no spare pad input): F9 quickload, direct hotkeys 1-0 (use F menu), X always-run toggle, C auto move.
